target.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Copilot BYOK users could have the local provider proxy buffer an unbounded request body before forwarding when the SDK sent an unexpectedly large POST.

## Why This Change Was Made

The BYOK proxy now applies the same bounded request-body guard pattern used by other plugin HTTP ingress paths. The intended BYOK proxy request-body cap is 16 MiB with a 30s read timeout; oversized requests are rejected locally with 413 before reaching the guarded upstream fetch.

## User Impact

Users keep the same BYOK provider behavior for normal SDK requests, while malformed or runaway local requests can no longer grow proxy memory without a cap.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.test.ts`: 4 tests passed
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.ts extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.test.ts`: passed
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.ts extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.test.ts`: passed
- Live BYOK proxy proof, run from the PR checkout with a local proof script that imports this branch's `createCopilotByokProxy`:

```text
$ node --import tsx <redacted-output-dir>/byok-live-proof.ts
normal_forward_status=200
normal_forward_request_method=POST
normal_forward_upstream=https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
normal_forward_body_bytes=29
normal_forward_response_content_type=application/dns-message
normal_forward_response_bytes=61
normal_forward_response_id=1234
oversized_status=413
oversized_body=Payload too large
configured_cap_bytes=16777216
oversized_request_bytes=16777217
```
